messages:
Ravi: Launching the OnPrem Consent & Audit Library v1.0 tonight for VPC/on‑prem customers. Purpose: standardized consent recording + signed audit bundle for customers who require evidence of telemetry choices. Rollout window and short checklist below. Ping with customer exceptions. :bell:
release-bot: Artifact uploaded: consent-audit-lib@v1.0 -> s3://internal-releases/consent-audit/v1.0. Window: 2025-09-10 22:00 UTC -> 2025-09-11 02:00 UTC. Canary 5% first 30m.
Elena: Quick Q 1: Does this change default telemetry behavior?
Ravi: No behavioral change: telemetry defaults remain off for new on-prem tenants. This library only captures and signs the customer's explicit choice and stores a hashed consent token in the audit bundle.
security-bot: Security note: audit bundles are signed with tenant-specific key material; we do not store raw prompt data. Hashing + HSM signing verified in staging.
support-lead: Support rota: @Elena and @Ravi covering the window. Please escalate failed bundle generation or key-access errors immediately.
Ravi: Customer readiness checklist:
- Ensure management port 15012 is reachable (agent -> management).
- Provide KMS/HSM access if they want locally-signed bundles.
- Decide consent policy and record signed consent via API or Console.
API example to record consent:
```
curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/9/consent -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"consent":true, "method":"signed-email"}'
```
Elena: Compliance: bundles include consent metadata, timestamp, and hashed metric keys. Retention configurable; default 90 days. We'll publish FAQ and customer template after rollout.
Ravi: I'll update the Console copy and post the customer email template here. Monitoring for 3h after rollout. Thanks all.
